_comment: Spell NAMES (as they appear in mythicsim-forever-engine/data/spells.jsonl) that Forte_Rogue tracks. gen_spell_data.py resolves each to its highest-rank spell ID + current duration/cooldown data. Names with no match in a given build are reported by the generator, not silently dropped -- re-check them after a mythicsim-forever-engine pull. Forever notes: the rogue base kit includes spells Cata-era rogues would not know -- Shadowstep (30 s core mobility), Between the Eyes (stun, shares kidney-shot category 270), Blade Flurry, Premeditation, Main Gauche, Redirect, Revealed Flaw, Ghostly Strike, Riposte, Rebuke, Blade Dance -- and the poison line has Forever-flavoured names (Atrophic, Sebacious, Venomhide, Occult, Glimpse of Madness, Blood Corruption). Vanish/Blind/Evasion/Sprint carry 5-min category cooldowns; Stealth sits in the shared stealth category 38 with druid Prowl; there is NO Shadow Dance, Shadowstrike and Mutilate have no cooldown fields in this build. Adrenaline Rush/Rebuke/Vigor name rows collide with pet/paladin/general rows; the generator picks the highest-rank row globally, fine for name-keyed cast tracking. Poisons are tracked at the highest craftable rank name only.
